To the detractors of SR4, I would like to offer an analogy of this rule, to rules in NSFW subverses. There are communities that are focused on non-nude sexy women, some that allow nakedness but not porn, and others that allow full on porn. It is not about limiting your free speech, which others have suggested in related posts; it is about deciding what the community would like to concentrate on and share. No one in the softcore sub is stopping a user from going to another subverse and posting pictures of porn. Just as no one here would be stopping someone from making their own sub that embraces shitty science. I see SR4 as defining this subverse, and what the community would like to embrace. I for one would like to see v/science be focused on science, not pseudoscience. If the majority of others would like to include pseudoscience, then that is something that I will deal with and accept.

I concede that there is risk of this rule being abused, so I hope the mods will error on the side of allowing content. That being said, if someone posts some article from a blogger who make claims that go against widely accepted ideas, and which does not offer data, or sources which contain actual data, to back up their claim... they can GTFO.
